sources.title: [Season 16] Ukantor´s Guide to Godyr (The best way to play it) (Master+ Build for AD and AP)

passive.name: Bridge Between
passive.text: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with Ultimate benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.

spells.name: Wilding Claw
spells.text: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.

spells.name: Iron Mantle
spells.text: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.

spells.name: Blazing Stampede
spells.text: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.

spells.name: Wingborne Storm
spells.text: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.

damage.value: Udyr deals physical damage with Wilding Claw’s next two empowered attacks.

archetype.value: Udyr can play as an AD fighter or a tanky AP champion who provides crowd control and staying power.

axis.value: Udyr favors short trades built around his next two empowered attacks.

winCondition.value: Udyr wins by using his strong one-on-one fighting to gain an advantage and climb.

spikes.why: Udyr gains its Ultimate benefits, strengthening his attacks, defenses, movement, or storm.

mistakes.value: Udyr misses Wilding Claw damage when he does not use its next two empowered attacks.
